candidate.text:
The levy is calculated in stages. First, 12% is applied to the first 3000 credits of the 2861-credit bill. Since the bill is only 2861 credits, the 12% is applied to the full 2861 credits. This is 0.12 * 2861 = 343.32. Then, we determine the remainder. Since the bill is only 2861 credits, and the first part of the levy was calculated on the whole bill, there is no remainder. Therefore, no 34% levy is applied. The initial levy is 343.32. 

Next, a 3-credit rebate is subtracted from the levy. This means 343.32 - 3 = 340.32. Because the rebate cannot result in a negative levy, the value remains positive. 

Finally, a 7% surcharge is applied to the reduced levy of 340.32. This is 0.07 * 340.32 = 23.8224. Adding this surcharge to the reduced levy results in 340.32 + 23.8224 = 364.1424. Therefore, the final levy is 364.1424.
